choice_data_list: So you were too afraid to get to sleep?

text_block_list.text: D-d-don't be a dummy! I'm not<n>scared of ghosts!

text_block_list.text:

thing! It was super<n>funny! Hahaha...

able to sleep and<n>didn't get much rest as a result.
